requirements.text: Hands-on backend software development experience with C#/.NET or Python and associated frameworks such as ASP.NET Core, FastAPI, or SQLAlchemy.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software design patterns, dependency injection, relational databases, and API development.
Experience developing production applications using modern development practices, including source control, testing, and CI/CD.
Familiarity with investment management, financial markets, portfolio analytics, or middle-office financial operations.
Exposure to SQL Server, Snowflake, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, or hybrid cloud infrastructure.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent programming experience, with an interest in emerging AI-assisted development tools.
